versions.description_html:
Discover how Windows Hello for Business replaces vulnerable passwords with secure biometric sign-ins, hardware-backed keys, and TPM chips in Microsoft 365.

Microsoft's cloud sees over three hundred million fraudulent sign-in attempts every day, and almost all of them are aimed at passwords. You might think the fix is a longer password, but the real fix is to take the password out of the picture.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why passwords fail
  • What Windows Hello for Business is
  • Your PIN is not a password
  • Where your face and fingerprint go
  • The chip that holds the key
  • How the sign-in works
  • Key trust, certificate trust, cloud trust
  • Windows Hello vs Windows Hello for Business
  • What this means for you

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
